entries.title: Acts 3:1
segments: The ninth hour. Three o'clock in the afternoon.  The other hours of prayer were nine o'clock in the forenoon, and twelve o'clock noon.

entries.title: Acts 3:2
segments:
:10
 
A certain man that was lame. In these verses the healing of the lame man by Peter is narrated.
 

 
Beautiful. The splendid Gate of Nicanor, facing the east.  It was built of Corinthian brass and ornamented with silver and gold.
 

 
In the name of Jesus Christ. Peter's faith in Christ was no longer to be shaken.  Its strength enabled him to heal the lame man.  He and the other apostles never attempted to perform a miracle except in the name of Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Acts 3:11
segments: The porch that is called Solomon's. A cloister on the east side of the Temple buildings.

entries.title: Acts 3:13
segments: The God of Abraham, etc.  A form of speech well adapted to win the confidence of the Jews.  It was their God who had done this miracle through His Servant, Jesus Christ.  But these conciliating words were immediately followed by a severe rebuke in

entries.title: Acts 3:15
segments: Whereof we are witnesses. A challenge to his hearers and to all other Jews to test the credibility of Peter and the other apostles as witnesses of the resurrection.

entries.title: Acts 3:16
segments: By faith in his name. In his person, teaching and power.

entries.title: Acts 3:17
segments: In ignorance ye did it. A concession which made Peter's appeal more effective.  See

.
 

 
Your rulers. They were more guilty than the people, yet even their ignorance is considerately judged.

entries.title: Acts 3:18
segments: That his Christ should suffer. See

entries.title: Acts 3:21
segments:
Must receive. Or, retain.
 

 
Restoration of all things. The perfecting of mankind through complete acceptance of Christ and his kingdom.

entries.title: Acts 3:22
segments: Like unto me, etc.  The coming and power of Jesus Christ foretold.

entries.title: Acts 3:26
segments: You first. The Jews first; afterward the Gentiles.
